manualFollowUps: Pages: merging publishes english-hub (free-today tags, used-for-today state, Theme of the week card, Telegram reminder settings). Until hub is deployed the theme card and reminder panel stay hidden or empty and the free state falls back to the old locked panel.

Database: supabase db push --linked --include-all only from an isolated copy of the installed migrations plus 20261023120000_english_telegram_reminders.sql and 20261023130000_english_registry_sync.sql, keeping the 9 pending payment migrations from #220 (20261010162000-20261010174000) excluded. Dry run first, then supabase migration list --linked. Adds a private english_reminder_secret row, invoke_english_reminders() and the hourly cron job english-reminders-v1 (minute 7). Nothing is sent until a learner turns reminders on. The registry sync adds update triggers on the 7 English content tables so admin status/title/level edits reach the learner catalog, and syncs rows edited before it.

verification: Without a session GET /functions/v1/hub/access and /hub/week return 401.
As a learner with no English plan: /hub/access shows free_left 1; the first activity submit returns 200, the second returns 402 english_free_limit_reached; Review stays available.
As a learner with a plan: /hub/access lists all seven entitled skills and submits are never limited.
cron.job lists english-reminders-v1 at '7 * * * *'; POST /functions/v1/hub/internal/reminders without the worker secret returns 401.
net._http_response shows the hourly call returning 200 with considered 0 until learners opt in.
Archiving a grammar unit in admin removes it from /hub/catalog; publishing it again brings it back.
